probes.text: Michael directs the Scranton staff as they film their own full-length Dunder Mifflin commercial.
Dwight sits alone at a computer, escaping from life by playing the game Second Life.
The office staff and other bar patrons gather to watch a commercial on the screens at Poor Richard's.
Michael, Dwight and Jim drive together to Utica for a so-called panty raid.
Jim, left in charge of the office, combines three staff birthdays that fall close together into one party.
Michael sits alone in the middle of a forest trying to prove he can survive on his own.
Dwight, told to leave, stays behind hidden in the forest while Michael tries to camp alone.
The Scranton office is caught up in a ping pong craze, with employees rallying around the table.
Dwight arrives at the condominium with his former babysitter as his date.
Michael and Jan host a dinner at their condominium for Jim, Pam, Andy and Angela.
Andy and Kevin sit down with neighboring business bosses to hash out building parking issues.
Dwight pursues a search for the female model pictured in the office chair catalog.
Michael studies a chair catalog and fixates on the female model pictured inside.
Michael and Dwight find Ryan clubbing in New York and join him for the night.
The Scranton staff working late find themselves locked in on the grounds with no escape.
Michael and Dwight show up in New York to surprise Ryan and meet his friends.
Pam is wearing her backup glasses and getting unwanted attention and comments about her different look.
Michael, Pam, Oscar and Darryl run a Dunder Mifflin booth at Pam's old high school job fair.
Jim plays golf with Andy and Kevin while trying to land a big client.
Dwight and Angela spend a tense day nearly alone together in the empty office.
Michael brandishes an oversized novelty cheque while a fake nurse stands beside him grinning.
Michael misunderstands his rental car's GPS directions and drives straight into Lake Scranton.
Michael gathers the office together to lead a seminar about ageism and older workers in the workplace.
Ryan stands in the Scranton office outlining his new technology plan to revitalize the struggling company.
Michael treats his digital launch invitation as an invitation to the real party in New York.
The Scranton staff gathers around a video chat screen for the company-wide website launch party.
Jim and Pam visit Dwight's family farm, which operates as a quirky bed and breakfast.

fine_only.text: Phyllis is running the party planning committee and setting up a huge goodbye bash for Toby.
